text:
marie: heads up — Odyssey Labs (acct ODY-1123) hit 45 days past due on INV-2024-089. CFO replied to dunning: "tight cashflow, can we split?" asked for 3 payments, 25% upfront. cc @ethan @sara

ethan: any disputed usage or credits that would alter the balance?

sara: legal stance? we usually avoid waiving fees but can be flexible with PA.

marie: checked portal, no disputes. proposed split: 25% now, then two equal installments. waive late fee if PA signed and schedule met.

ethan: collections supports conditional split. require proof of upfront payment and ACH mandate; prefer ACH over card.

omkar: Omkar from Finance 2: agree if we log plan in billing ledger and capture txn id. also request payment method on file and set system reminders.

jess: CS update 2: CFO on call said ACH ok, requested invoice showing the split. emailed us "we can do this, send PA". I uploaded the email to #customer-docs.

marie: I'll draft PA and revised invoice. proposed schedule:
```
INV-2024-089 total: $48,000
Upfront (25%): $12,000 due within 5 business days of signed PA
Installment A (37.5%): $18,000 due 30 days after upfront payment
Installment B (37.5%): $18,000 due 60 days after upfront payment
Late fee: waived while PA active and payments on time; standard late fee reinstated on missed payment after 5-day cure window
```

sara: legal ok with that paragraph and the 5-day cure window. add right to re-open collections if they default.

marie: added cure clause. @billing-bot please create invoice revision and attach PA template.

billing-bot: Created invoice revision INV-2024-089.rev1 and attached PA template. https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2024-089/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Placed temporary hold on escalation for ODY-1123 pending PA and upfront payment. Reminder scheduled in 7 days.

ethan: once upfront posts, update ledger, clear delinquency flag, and notify CS to upload ACH mandate. Omkar to approve late fee waiver after verification.

jess: uploaded ACH mandate form sent to CFO and the acceptance screenshot to #customer-docs. CFO replied "I'll sign and return by tomorrow." :pray:

omkar: OK to waive late fee conditionally. Omkar final sign-off after we see txn id for the 25% and signed PA. finance will apply payment upon clearing.

marie: I'll send the PA + revised invoice to Odyssey with a 5-business-day deadline for the upfront. If no payment or signed PA by next Wed, we'll remove hold and resume escalation. Thanks all. :handshake:
